subject: Re: Pickup quote 93294 Regensburg to MUC on 2026-11-25
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for reaching out! We can collect in Regensburg and deliver to the air export warehouse at MUC for an all-in price of 294.41 EUR. The pickup time is 6 hours, and the quote is valid until 22 Nov 2026 03:15 UTC.

Our offer reference is TRK-11907. No booking is needed for the pickup.

Best,
Flinkwagen Logistik
